name: rafeeq-frontend
description: Rafeeq frontend workspace (student, driver, admin + shared packages)

scripts.lint: eslint student-app driver-app packages --ext .ts,.tsx && npm run lint --workspace=admin-dashboard
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=packages/tokens && npm run test --workspace=packages/ui
scripts.check: npm run check:tokens && npm run check:icons && npm run check:design && npm run check:parity && npm run check:identity && npm run check:money && npm run check:invariants
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/tokens && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/api-client && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/ui && npm run typecheck --workspace=student-app && npm run typecheck --workspace=driver-app && npm run typecheck --workspace=admin-dashboard
